Why Separate Organic Waste?
About 24% of solid waste in landfills is food waste.
Food waste causes 58% of landfill methane
emissions.
Organic waste recycling facilities capture methane,
a climate-warming gas, to generate power.
The emissions of food waste in landfills is equivalent
to the emissions of over 50 million gas-powered
passenger vehicles.
Organic recycling creates compost, a type of natural
fertilizer, which contains recycled nutrients.
When added to soil, compost promotes soil health &
reduces the need for synthetic fertilizer.
It’s the law!
Important Definitions
Compostable: Organic materials that break down into natural compounds.
Biodegradable: Organic and/or inorganic materials that break down into natural and/or synthetic compounds.
